sentence_ibo_Latn: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’
sentence_eng_Latn: Welsh AMs worried about 'looking like muppets'

sentence_ibo_Latn: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
sentence_eng_Latn: There is consternation among some AMs at a suggestion their title should change to MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.
sentence_eng_Latn: It has arisen because of plans to change the name of the assembly to the Welsh Parliament.

sentence_ibo_Latn: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.
sentence_eng_Latn: AMs across the political spectrum are worried it could invite ridicule.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”
sentence_eng_Latn: One Labour AM said his group was concerned "it rhymes with Twp and Pwp."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.
sentence_eng_Latn: For readers outside of Wales: In Welsh twp means daft and pwp means poo.

sentence_ibo_Latn: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.
sentence_eng_Latn: A Plaid AM said the group as a whole was "not happy" and has suggested alternatives.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.
sentence_eng_Latn: A Welsh Conservative said his group was "open minded" about the name change, but noted it was a short verbal hop from MWP to Muppet.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.
sentence_eng_Latn: In this context The Welsh letter w is pronounced similarly to the Yorkshire English pronunciation of the letter u.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”
sentence_eng_Latn: The Assembly Commission, which is currently drafting legislation to introduce the name changes, said: "The final decision on any descriptors of what Assembly Members are called will of course be a matter for the members themselves."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.
sentence_eng_Latn: The Government of Wales Act 2017 gave the Welsh assembly the power to change its name.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.
sentence_eng_Latn: In June, the Commission published the results of a public consultation on the proposals which found broad support for calling the assembly a Welsh Parliament.

sentence_ibo_Latn: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.
sentence_eng_Latn: On the matter of the AMs' title, the Commission favoured Welsh Parliament Members or WMPs, but the MWP option received the most support in a public consultation.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.
sentence_eng_Latn: AMs are apparently suggesting alternative options, but the struggle to reach consensus could be a headache for the Presiding Officer, Elin Jones, who is expected to submit draft legislation on the changes within weeks.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: The legislation on the reforms will include other changes to the way the assembly works, including rules on disqualification of AMs and the design of the committee system.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: AMs will get the final vote on the question of what they should be called when they debate the legislation.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha
sentence_eng_Latn: Macedonians go to polls in referendum on changing country's name

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atuli aka na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ “Repọbliki nke North Macedonia.”
sentence_eng_Latn: Voters will vote Sunday on whether to change their country's name to the "Republic of North Macedonia."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Atọlitere ntuli aka nke igwe mmadụ iji kpezie esemokwu ogologo oge dị n’etiti ndị agbataobi bụ Greece, nke nwere mpaghara nke ya akpọrọ Macedonia.
sentence_eng_Latn: The popular vote was set up in a bid to resolve a decades-long dispute with neighboring Greece, which has its own province called Macedonia.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.
sentence_eng_Latn: Athens has long insisted that its northern neighbor's name represents a claim on its territory and has repeatedly objected to its membership bids for the EU and NATO.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov nke Macedonia, onye iro nke ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ, ekwuola na ọ ga-eleghara ntuli aka ahụ anya.
sentence_eng_Latn: Macedonian President Gjorge Ivanov, an opponent of the plebiscite on the name change, has said he will disregard the vote.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Kaosiladị, ndị nkwado nke nhọpụta ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrụ aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.
sentence_eng_Latn: However, supporters of the referendum, including Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, argue that the name change is simply the price to pay to join the EU and NATO.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Mgbịrịmgba nke St. Martin Dara Jụụ ka Ndị Ụlọ Ụka dị na Harlem Na Agba Mba
sentence_eng_Latn: The Bells of St. Martin's Fall Silent as Churches in Harlem Struggle

sentence_ibo_Latn: “N’akụkọ ochie, ndị okenye m gwara okwu kwuru na enwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n’akụkụ niile,” Maazị Adams kwuru.
sentence_eng_Latn: "Historically, the old people I've talked to say there was a bar and a church on every corner," Mr. Adams said.

sentence_ibo_Latn: “Taa, enweghị nke ọ bụla.”
sentence_eng_Latn: "Today, there's neither."

sentence_ibo_Latn: O kwuru na aghọtara ọpụpụ nke ụlọ mmanya ndị ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: He said the disappearance of bars was understandable.

sentence_ibo_Latn: “Ndị mmadụ na emerịkọta n’ụzọ dị iche iche” ugbu a, o kwuru.
sentence_eng_Latn: "People socialize in a different way" nowadays, he said.

sentence_ibo_Latn: “Ụlọ mmanya abụghịzị ime ụlọ nke gburugburu ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga kwa oge.”
sentence_eng_Latn: "Bars are no longer neighborhood living rooms where people go on a regular basis."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Maka ndị ụlọ ụka, ọ na echekasị na ego enwetere na ịre akụ agaghị anọte aka otu ndị isi si chee, “ma n’oge adịghị anya ma ọ bụ emechaa ha ga-alaghachite ebe ha bidoro.”
sentence_eng_Latn: As for churches, he worries that the money from selling assets will not last as long as leaders expect it to, "and sooner or later they'll be right back where they started."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ndị ụlọ ụka, o tinyere, na enwere ike iji nnukwu ụlọ obibi nwere dochie ha, nke eji ụdị ndị mmadụ na agaghị enyere aka n’ebe nsọ nke gburugburu ahụ fọdụrụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: Churches, he added, could be replaced by apartment buildings with condominiums filled with the kind of people who will not help the neighborhood's remaining sanctuaries.

sentence_ibo_Latn: “Nnukwu imirikiti ndị mmadụ na azụta nkewa ụlọ n’ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha, “o kwuru, “ya mere ha ga-eme ka ụbọchị nke ndị ụlọ ụka a ga-emechi kpamkpam bịa ngwangwa n’ihi ọ ga-esi ike imirikiti ndị mmadụ na akwabata n’ime ụlọ ndị a bụrụ ndị otu nke ụlọ ụka ndị a.”
sentence_eng_Latn: "The overwhelming majority of people who buy condominiums in these buildings will be white," he said, "and therefore will hasten the day that these churches close altogether because it is unlikely that most of these people who move into these condominiums will become members of these churches."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ụlọ ụka abụọ ahụ bụ ndị mgbakọ ndị ọcha rụrụ ha tupu Harlem abụrụ obodo ndị isi ojii - Ogbe Obodo Ukwuu na 1870, St. Martin bụ afọ iri ka emechara.
sentence_eng_Latn: Both churches were built by white congregations before Harlem became a black metropolis - Metropolitan Community in 1870, St. Martin's a decade later.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ọgbakọ ndị Methodist nke izizi pụrụ na 1930.
sentence_eng_Latn: The original white Methodist congregation moved out in the 1930s.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ọgbakọ ndị isii ojii nọ na efe ofufe n’akụkụ wegara aha n’ụlọ ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: A black congregation that had been worshiping nearby took title to the building.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ndị ọgbakọ isi ojii weghara St. Martin n’okpuru Rev. John Howard Johnson, onye duru mgbochi nke ndị mgbere ahịa dị na Okporo Ụzọ 125, isi okporo ụzọ maka ịzụ ahịa dị na Harlem, ndị gbochiri ịwere ma ọ bụ ịkwado ndị isi ojii n’ahịa.
sentence_eng_Latn: St. Martin's was taken over by a black congregation under the Rev. John Howard Johnson, who led a boycott of retailers on 125th Street, a main street for shopping in Harlem, who resisted hiring or promoting blacks.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ọkụ gbara na 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nnukwu, mana ka ndị ụka nke Fada Johnson haziri ịrụgharị ụlọ ahụ, ha rụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: A fire in 1939 left the building badly damaged, but as Father Johnson's parishioners made plans to rebuild, they commissioned the carillon.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Rev. David Johnson, nwa Fada Johnson yana onye nọchiri na St. Martin, ji obi aṅụrị kpọọ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ “mgbịrịmgba nke ndị ogbenye.”
sentence_eng_Latn: The Rev. David Johnson, Father Johnson's son and successor at St. Martin's, proudly called the carillon "the poor people's bells."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ọkachamara onye kụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ na Julaị kpọrọ ya ihe ọzọ: “Akụ omenala” yana “akụrụngwa akụkọ ihe mere eme enweghị ike idochi.”
sentence_eng_Latn: The expert who played the carillon in July called it something else: "A cultural treasure" and "an irreplaceable historical instrument."

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ọkachamara ahụ, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum nke Michigan, kwukwara na ọ bụ igwe mgbịrịmgba izizi dị n’ụwa nke onye egwu isi ojii ga-akpọ, Dionisio A. Lind, onye nke gara n’igwe mgbịrịmgba ka ibu dị na Ụlọ Ụka Riverside afọ 18 gara aga.
sentence_eng_Latn: The expert, Tiffany Ng of the University of Michigan, also noted that it was the first carillon in the world to be played by a black musician, Dionisio A. Lind, who moved to the larger carillon at the Riverside Church 18 years ago.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Maazị Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin anọchighi ya.
sentence_eng_Latn: Mr. Merriweather said that St. Martin's did not replace him.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ihe akpọrọ na St. Martin n’ofe ọnwa ole ma ole gara aga bụ akụkọ nke ndị ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta gbagwojuru anya, ụfọdụ nke ndị ndu nke ụlọ ụka ahụ webatara, ndị ọzọ bụ nke ngalaba ụka dị n’okpuru ọchịchị ndị Bishọpụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: What has played out at St. Martin's over the last few months has been a complicated tale of architects and contractors, some brought in by the lay leaders of the church, others by the Episcopal diocese.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ụlọ ọzụzụ - otu nchịkwa nke ụlọ ụka ahụ, nke ndị ndu juputara - degara ngalaba ụka ahụ na Julaị maka echiche na ngalaba ụka ahụ “ga-achọ ịnyefe ụgwọ ndị ahụ” n’aka ụlọ ozuzu ahụ, ọbụlagodi na ụlọ ozuzu ahụ etinyeghị aka na iwere ndi ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta na ngalaba ụka ahụ ezitere.
sentence_eng_Latn: The vestry - the parish's governing body, made up of lay leaders - wrote the diocese in July with concerns that the diocese "would seek to pass along the costs" to the vestry, even though the vestry had not been involved in hiring the architects and contractors the diocese sent in.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ụfọdụ ndị ụka kpesara ụkọ nke mkpughe na ngalaba ụka ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: Some parishioners complained of a lack of transparency on the diocese's part.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Shark merụrụ nwa afọ 13 ahụ na mmanye lọbsta dị na California
sentence_eng_Latn: Shark injures 13-year-old on lobster dive in California

sentence_ibo_Latn: Shark makpuru ma merụọ nwa nwoke afọ 13 ahụ na Satọde ka ọ na amanye na mmiri maka lọbsta na California n’ụbọchị mmepe nke oge lọbsta, ndị ikike kwuru.
sentence_eng_Latn: A shark attacked and injured a 13-year-old boy Saturday while he was diving for lobster in California on the opening day of lobster season, officials said.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Mmakpu ahụ mere tupu 7 ụtụtụ n’akụkụ Osimiri nke Beacon na Encinitas.
sentence_eng_Latn: The attack occurred just before 7 a.m. near Beacon's Beach in Encinitas.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Chad Hammel gwara KSWB-TV na San Diego na ya na ndị enyi nọ na amanye na mmiri ihe dị ka ọkara aka elekere n’ụtụtụ Satọde mgbe ọ nụrụ ka nwa nwoke ahụ na eti mkpu enyemaka, mgbe ahụ ya na ụfọdụ kworo ụgbọ gafee iji nyere aka dọpụta ya n’ime mmiri.
sentence_eng_Latn: Chad Hammel told KSWB-TV in San Diego he had been diving with friends for about half an hour Saturday morning when he heard the boy screaming for help and then paddled over with a group to help pull him out of the water.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Hammel kwuru n’izizi na ọ chere na ọ bụ ihe ọhụụ nke ijide lọbsta, mana mgbe ahụ ọ “chọpụtara na ọ na eti, “atara m!
sentence_eng_Latn: Hammel said at first he thought it was just excitement of catching a lobster, but then he "realized that he was yelling, 'I got bit!

sentence_ibo_Latn: Atara m!'
sentence_eng_Latn: I got bit!'

sentence_ibo_Latn: Adọpuru ọkpụkpụ ụkwụ ya niile, “ Hammel kwuru na ọ chọpụtara ozugbo o rutere nwa nwoke ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: His whole clavicle was ripped open," Hammel said he noticed once he got to the boy.

sentence_ibo_Latn: “Etiri m mkpu ka mmadụ niile pụta na mmiri ahụ: ‘Enwere shark n’ime mmiri ahụ!”” Hammel tinyere.
sentence_eng_Latn: "I yelled at everyone to get out of the water: 'There's a shark in the water!'" Hammel added.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Eji ụgbọ elu buru nwa nwoke ahụ gaa Ụlọ Ọgwụ Ụmụaka Rady dị na San Diego ebe edebanyere ya n’ọnọdụ ihe egwu.
sentence_eng_Latn: The boy was airlifted to Rady Children's Hospital in San Diego where he is listed in critical condition.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Amaghị ụdị nke shark mere mmakpu ahụ.
sentence_eng_Latn: The species of shark responsible for the attack was unknown.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles kwuru na nchịkọta akụkọ na ahụrụ shark na mpaghara ahụ n’izu ole ma ole gara aga, mana ekpebiri na ọ bụghị ụdị shark jọrọ njọ.
sentence_eng_Latn: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles said at a media briefing that a shark had been spotted in the area a few weeks earlier, but it was determined not to be a dangerous species of shark.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Giles tinyere na onye ahụ ihe mere nwere mmerụ ahụ buru ibu n’akụkụ elu ahụ ya.
sentence_eng_Latn: Giles added the victim sustained traumatic injuries to his upper torso area.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ndị ikike mechiri osimiri ahụ bido na Akụkụ Osimiri Ponto dị na Casablad ruo Swami dị na Ecinitas n’ime aka elekere 48 maka ebumnuche nnyocha na nchedo.
sentence_eng_Latn: Officials shut down beach access from Ponto Beach in Casablad to Swami's in Ecinitas for 48 hours for investigation and safety purposes.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Giles kwukwara na enwere karịa ụdị shark 135 dị na mpaghara ahụ, mana anaghị ahụta imirikiti ka ndị jọrọ njọ.
sentence_eng_Latn: Giles noted that there are more than 135 shark species in the area, but most are not considered dangerous.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Atụmatụ nke Sainbury ịbanye n’ahịa ihe ịchọ mma nke UK
sentence_eng_Latn: Sainsbury's plans push into UK beauty market

sentence_ibo_Latn: Sainbury na eche Boots, Superdrug na Debenhams aka mgba site na iji warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma nwere nka-ụlọ ahịa eji ndị enyemaka ọkachamara kpojuo.
sentence_eng_Latn: Sainsbury's is taking on Boots, Superdrug and Debenhams with department store-style beauty aisles staffed with specialist assistants.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Dị akụkụ nke ọkpụrụkpụ mbanye n’ime ahịa ihe ịchọ mma £2.8n nke UK, nke na aga n’ihu etolite ebe ahịa uwe na ngwa ụlọ na alaghachi, a ga-anwale warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma n’ime ụlọ ahịa 11 na gburugburu obodo ahụ ma buga ya n’ụlọ ahịa ndị ọzọ n’afọ na esote ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gaa nke ọma.
sentence_eng_Latn: As part of a substantial push into the UK's £2.8bn beauty market, which is continuing to grow while fashion and homeware sales fall back, the larger beauty aisles will be tested out in 11 stores around the country and taken to more stores next year if it proves a success.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Nkwanye ego n’ihe ịchọ mma na abịa ka ụlọ ahịa na achụ ụzọ iji mejuo oghere nke edobeburu maka Igwe onyonyoo, mikrowevụ na ngwa ụlọ.
sentence_eng_Latn: The investment in beauty comes as supermarkets hunt for ways to use up shelf space once sued for TVs, microwaves and homeware.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Sainsbury kwuru na ọ ga-abasa nha nke ngwaahịa ihe ịchọ mma ya ruo ngwaahịa 3,000, gụnyere ụlọ ọrụ dị ka Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman na Dr. PawPaw nke izizi.
sentence_eng_Latn: Sainsbury's said it would be doubling the size of its beauty offering to up to 3,000 products, including brands such as Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman and Dr. PawPaw for the first time.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Oke ndị dị adị malite na L'Oreal, Maybelline na Burt’s Bees ga-enwetakwa oghere na mpaghara nwere akara yitere ndị ahụ ahụrụ n’ụlọ ahịa dị ka Boots.
sentence_eng_Latn: Existing ranges from L'Oreal, Maybelline and Burt's Bees will also get more space with branded areas similar to those found in shops like Boots.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ụlọ ahịa ndị ahụ na amalitegharị ahịa ihe ịchọ mma Ụlọ Ahịa ya ka imirikiti ngwaahịa ahụ bụrụ nke na emejọghị ụmụ anụmanụ - ihe ndị ahịa na etolite na achọ nnukwu ugbu a.
sentence_eng_Latn: The supermarket is also relaunching its Boutique makeup range so that the majority of products are vegan-friendly - something increasingly demanded by younger shoppers.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Na mgbakwunye, ndị mgbere isi ụtọ Fragrance Shop ga-anwale ikikere n’ụlọ ahịa Sainsbury abụọ, nke izizi emepere na Croydon, ndịda London, izu gara aga ebe nke abụọ ga-emepe na Selly Oak, Birmingham, emechaa n’afọ a.
sentence_eng_Latn: In addition, perfume retailer the Fragrance Shop will be testing out concessions in two Sainsbury's stores, the first of which opened in Croydon, south London, last week while a second opens in Selly Oak, Birmingham, later this year.

sentence_ibo_Latn: Ịzụ ahịa n’ịntanetị na mbugharị gaa na ịzụ obere nri kwa ụbọchị na ntakịrị ụlọ ahịa dị na mpaghara pụtara na ndị nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na enwekwu ọrụ ịrụ iji mee ka ndị mmadụ bịa.
